ground_truth_provenance.basis: Checked scripts read released targets; no model-generated reference labels or hidden-gold fallback were found.

metric_denominators.basis: Explicit test denominators and fixed five-seed aggregation are used; no self-normalization or best-seed selection was found.

structured_serialization.basis: Reports now expose deterministic_serialization_validity and exclude it from model-performance interpretation.

auxiliary_label_support.basis: Clean test support is one label across 145 records; OOD support is 16096/305; majority accuracy is recorded.

result_existence_and_claim_binding.basis: The claim-evidence map binds official, strict, template, proxy-reduced, challenge, near-neighbour-free, target-hidden, structured, OPF, rule, translation, and native-replay reports to real nested JSON paths.

metric_invocation.basis: Declared TF-IDF, structured, Transformer, target-hidden, and bootstrap metrics are called in the checked scripts.

scope_and_evaluation_type.basis: Five seeds are fixed; neural budgets are warm-start references; MinHash is an approximate self-supervised proxy; human review is uncompleted.

external_gates: final author, credit, and funding metadata
